newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SAL offers 80 mln shares in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: SAL offers 80 mln shares in rights issue.

text.p: Singapore-listed plastics company Showpla Asia Ltd (SAL) said on Wednesday it had proposed a one-for-one rights issue of 80 million new ordinary shares and applied for a secondary listing on the Osaka Securities Exchange.
SAL said in a statement it expected to raise US$14.9 million from the issue of shares of par value Singapore $0.25 each at US$0.19 for each rights share.
Proceeds from the issue, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval, would be used to repay bank borrowings, part finance expansion in Indonesia and for working capital.
Three of SAL's major shareholders -- Showa Plastics Co Ltd, Nomura/Jafco Investment (Asia) Ltd and Sumitomo Corp -- had agreed to subscribe or procure subscriptions for 54 million of the shares.
The balance of 26 million shares would be underwritten by Nomura Singapore Ltd and DBS Bank Ltd, SAL said.
The deal would be co-underwritten by OCBC Bank Ltd, Yamaichi Merchant Bank (Singapore) Ltd and New Japan Merchant Bank (Singapore) Ltd.
In line with the rights issue and secondary listing, SAL said it proposed an increase in its authorised share capital to S$50 million from S$30 million.
